title: Weapons

schemaVersion.description: Version of this file's layout. It changes only when the layout does.

gameBuild.description: Steam build id the data was extracted from.

units.description: Unit of every distance in the file. Speeds are meters per second.

name.description: Display name, as in items.json (the game's UI table). Absent when the game has none.

asset.description: Path of the weapon stats asset inside the game files.

calibers.description: Calibers the weapon fires (the game's `Item.Caliber.*` tags without the prefix).

muzzleVelocity.description: Muzzle velocity in meters per second.

effectiveRange.description: Range in meters the game tunes the weapon for.

damageFalloff.description: Damage multiplier by distance. Between points the game interpolates as each point's `interpolation` says (linear when absent), and holds the first value before the first point and the last after the last.

multiplier.description: Damage multiplier at that distance (1 is full damage).

interpolation.description: How the game interpolates from this point to the next, when it is not linear. Absent means linear. A cubic segment follows the game's own tangents, which are not published, so treat it as a smooth curve between the two points.

accuracy.description: Accuracy rating as stored. Larger values go with looser weapons in the data (SV98 0.56, AK74M 0.825, M500 1.5, RPG-7 3.0), so compare weapons of one class.

adsTime.description: Seconds to aim down sights through iron sights.

zeroing.description: Sight zeroing range in meters. Absent for weapons without zeroing.

suppressionMultiplier.description: Multiplier on the suppression the weapon causes.

windupTime.description: Seconds between pulling the trigger and the first shot, for weapons that spin up.

recoil.description: Recoil. Absent for weapons the game gives no pattern.

pattern.description: The game's `RecoilPattern`: one x and y pair per shot, as stored. In the data x is sideways and y is upward for nearly every shot (a few shots of two weapons pull slightly down); the game gives no unit.

patternResetTime.description: Seconds without firing before the pattern restarts.

afterPatternPitch.description: Random extra upward kick once the pattern has ended, [min, max], as stored (the game's `PostPatternRandomPitchRecoil`).

afterPatternYaw.description: Random extra sideways kick once the pattern has ended, [min, max], as stored (the game's `PostPatternRandomYawRecoil`).

shotgun.description: Spread of a shotgun's pellets. Absent for other weapons.

chokeFactor.description: Choke, as stored (higher tightens the spread).

outerConeHalfAngle.description: Half angle of the outer spread cone, in degrees.

innerConeMultiplier.description: Inner cone size as a multiple of the outer cone.

randomConeHalfAngleRange.description: Random extra half angle added to the cone: [min, max] in degrees.

slot.description: Slot type, for example `Sight` or `Magazine` (the game's `Item.Attachment.*` tag without its prefix).

contexts.description: Item context tags accepted: anything carrying one of these tags fits.

filter.description: The game's filter mode: `AllowList` accepts only the listed items and contexts, `BlockPriority` accepts all except what is blocked.

default.description: Item the weapon starts with in this slot.

hidden.description: Slot is not shown to players (chamber, built-in parts).

items.description: One attachment slot on a weapon.

slots.description: Attachment slots from the weapon's item definition.

weapons.description: One entry per weapon, sorted by item id.

description: Weapon statistics (fire rate, ballistics, recoil, accuracy) and the attachment slots of each weapon. Weapon ids are item ids from items.json.
